gotchas: Signup is a Travel ID / Miles & More enrolment that lives OFF this host, at https://lufthansa.miles-and-more.com/web/row/en/enrolment.html . From lufthansa.com: footer 'Travel ID Account' -> /us/en/travel-id -> 'Register now' (opens a new tab). /us/en/registration renders an empty page, and the header 'Login' link did nothing visible in testing.

A OneTrust cookie wall covers lufthansa.com and intercepts clicks: click #onetrust-reject-all-handler first. The first homepage load in one proxy session was a Cloudflare 'Performing security verification' interstitial (challenges.cloudflare.com, detectChallenge = captcha) that did not clear; a fresh session loaded normally. An invisible Turnstile frame is present on the homepage.

Five steps: Registration (access details) -> Miles & More -> Personal data -> Communication -> Confirmation. Step 1 is only 'Travel ID (email address)' (input[name="email"]) and a password (input[name="password"], autocomplete new-password), then Continue. Later steps were not observed.

There are 4 'Continue' buttons and 12 submit buttons in the DOM (one per hidden step); only one is visible, so target button[type="submit"]:visible (or role=button[name="Continue"]). Two input[type="email"] exist, so use the name.
